text:
Mats Zuccarello is 39, in his first season in Los Angeles after 452 games in Minnesota, and the early returns are mixed. He's played 11 games, with a gap from late October to Nov. 10, and has 3 points. That's well under the near three points per 60 minutes he managed with the Wild last season, when he had 54 points in 59 games.

The good news came in his last two games: goals against Calgary and in a shutout win in Boston. The less good news is at five on five, where the Kings take 46% of the expected goals with him on the ice, six points worse than without him, and his ice time has dropped by about three and a half minutes from his usual. His own chance quality is low, but he was never a shooter: he's a passer with 512 career assists.

Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.7 wins last season, mostly from even-strength offense, so the talent was there a year ago. Eleven games is too small to say what's left. The thing to watch is whether the assists return as he settles in with new linemates.
headline: Zuccarello, a Kings newcomer still finding his footing
